hist.zh: 江宁东西向干道，路名取吉语；S1、5号线换乘站。
hist.en: An east–west Jiangning avenue; interchange of Lines S1 and 5.

hist.zh: 九龙湖南岸的新兴居住区。
hist.en: A new residential quarter on the south shore of Jiulonghu Lake.

hist.zh: 江宁大学城干道，路名取『诚信』嘉言；3、5号线换乘站。
hist.en: A university-town avenue named for integrity; interchange of Lines 3 and 5.

hist.zh: 江宁老村落名，地名沿用。
hist.en: An old Jiangning village name still in use.

hist.zh: 取『科技宁乡』之意的新区路名。
hist.en: A new-district road blending 'science' and 'Jiangning'.

hist.zh: 东山老城南北干道，地名沿用旧村落名；1、5号线换乘站。
hist.en: An old Dongshan north–south road; interchange of Lines 1 and 5.

hist.zh: 纪念东晋新亭，『新亭对泣』典故之地。
hist.en: Recalls Xinting of the Eastern Jin, home of the famed 'weeping at Xinting' story.

hist.zh: 江宁区驻地，『东山再起』典故出自东晋谢安。
hist.en: Seat of Jiangning District, source of the idiom 'a comeback from East Hill' (Xie An).

hist.zh: 路名取『文靖』雅号。
hist.en: A road named after the scholarly posthumous title Wenjing.

hist.zh: 以香樟树闻名的大片居住绿地。
hist.en: A residential quarter known for its camphor trees.

hist.zh: 明代京军神机营驻地，中国最早成建制的火器部队。
hist.en: Base of the Ming Divine Machine Camp, China's first organized firearms corps.

hist.zh: 明代演武校场，后为大校场机场，2015年停用转型南部新城；5、10号线换乘站。
hist.en: The Ming drill ground, later the airfield closed in 2015; interchange of Lines 5 and 10.

hist.zh: 明代七孔石桥，南京现存最大古石拱桥之一。
hist.en: A seven-arch Ming stone bridge, among Nanjing's largest ancient arch bridges.

hist.zh: 老城南东缘的老地名。
hist.en: An old place name on the eastern edge of the old city.

hist.zh: 明都城南门正阳门，民国改称光华门。
hist.en: The Ming south gate Zhengyangmen, renamed Guanghuamen in the Republican era.

hist.zh: 明代内城门，旧为水陆交通枢纽。
hist.en: A Ming inner-city gate, once a water–land transport hub.

hist.zh: 始建于宋的孔庙建筑群，与秦淮画舫、江南贡院同为文化地标。
hist.en: The Confucius Temple complex, with Qinhuai boats and the exam halls.

hist.zh: 明清以来繁华街市，地名传与『三山』古称相关。
hist.en: A bustling street since the Ming and Qing, named for the ancient Three Hills.

hist.zh: 江南现存规模最大的古建筑群，明代为朝天祭祀之所。
hist.en: The largest ancient building complex in Jiangnan, a Ming court for imperial rites.

hist.zh: 民国风貌街区，旧时使馆区片区之一。
hist.en: A Republican-era street through the old consular quarter.

hist.zh: 山形似五台得名，今为体育中心与先锋书店所在。
hist.en: Named for its five terraces; now a sports center and home to a famed bookstore.

hist.zh: 以省名命名的老城路名，民国时已见记载。
hist.en: An old street named after Yunnan province, recorded in the Republican era.

hist.zh: 湖南路商圈的市民广场。
hist.en: A civic plaza in the Hunan Road shopping area.

hist.zh: 旧有虹桥跨河的老地名。
hist.en: An old name from a former arched bridge over the creek.

hist.zh: 以福建省命名的老城路名。
hist.en: An old street named after Fujian province.

hist.zh: 旧时官盐仓旁桥头老地名。
hist.en: An old name from the bridge by the government salt warehouse.

hist.zh: 长江老码头商埠区，南京近代开埠门户。
hist.en: The old Yangtze port district, Nanjing's gateway in the treaty-port era.

hist.zh: 明永乐敕建，郑和屡驻于此；1842年《南京条约》议约地。
hist.en: An imperial Ming temple tied to Zheng He; where the Treaty of Nanjing was negotiated in 1842.

hist.zh: 1908年沪宁铁路始发站，百年老站房仍在。
hist.en: The 1908 terminus of the Shanghai–Nanjing Railway; its old house still stands.

hist.zh: 下关滨江老村落名。
hist.en: An old village name in the Xiaguan riverside area.

hist.zh: 仙林北部新路，7号线北端起点。
hist.en: A new northern Xianlin road; northern terminus of Line 7.

hist.zh: 明代外郭城门尧化门故地。
hist.en: Site of Yaohua Gate of the Ming outer wall.

hist.zh: 尧化门旁的大型居住区。
hist.en: A large residential quarter beside Yaohua Gate.

hist.zh: 丁家庄保障房片区南部。
hist.en: Southern part of the Dingjiazhuang housing district.

hist.zh: 南京大型保障居住片区。
hist.en: One of Nanjing's major public-housing districts.

hist.zh: 老地名万寿村。
hist.en: Named after the old Wanshou village.

hist.zh: 1927年陶行知在此创办晓庄师范，开中国乡村教育之先河。
hist.en: Where Tao Xingzhi founded Xiaozhuang Normal School in 1927, pioneering rural education.

hist.zh: 长江南岸丘陵，达摩『一苇渡江』传说之地。
hist.en: Hills on the Yangtze's south bank, tied to Bodhidharma's reed-crossing legend.

hist.zh: 老地名『五塘』，旧为城北水塘密布之地。
hist.en: The old Five Ponds place name of the city's north.

hist.zh: 幕府山以西干道。
hist.en: The road west of Mufu Hill.

hist.zh: 城北新路，名承金陵『钟阜』旧称。
hist.en: A northern road named after Jinling's old epithet Zhongfu.

hist.zh: 以福建省命名的老城路名。
hist.en: An old street named after Fujian province.

hist.zh: 滨江岗地老地名。
hist.en: An old name for this riverside ridge.

hist.zh: 清末增辟的城门之一，今为城西干道要冲。
hist.en: A gate opened in the late Qing; now a busy western artery.

hist.zh: 六朝石头城所在，『石城虎踞』之源。
hist.en: Home of the Stone City, source of the phrase 'the crouching tiger of Stone City'.

hist.zh: 相传南朝美女莫愁女居此，号称『金陵第一名胜』。
hist.en: Legend of Mochou, the sorrow-free maiden — 'the finest sight of Jinling'.

hist.zh: 因观音大士庙前茶亭得名。
hist.en: Named after a tea pavilion before an old Guanyin shrine.

hist.zh: 老城南湖居住区，湖名沿用。
hist.en: The old South Lake residential district.

hist.zh: 路名取明都『应天府』。
hist.en: A road named after the Ming capital's name, Yingtianfu.

hist.zh: 梦都大街东段。
hist.en: The eastern section of Mengdu Avenue.

hist.zh: 建邺高新区的科技园区。
hist.en: The tech park of Jianye's high-tech zone.

hist.zh: 河西中部老地名，今为新城商务片区；7、10号线换乘站。
hist.en: A mid-Hexi old district, now a business quarter; interchange of Lines 7 and 10.

hist.zh: 河西南部街巷名。
hist.en: A street in Hexi's southern new town.

hist.zh: 河西南部新城路名。
hist.en: A southern Hexi new-town street.

hist.zh: 河西南部路名。
hist.en: A southern Hexi road name.

hist.zh: 旧时水塘密布之地，路名存水乡记忆；2、7号线换乘站。
hist.en: Once a land of ponds — the name keeps the memory; interchange of Lines 2 and 7.

hist.zh: 明代古桥西善桥得名；7、S2号线换乘站。
hist.en: Named after the Ming-era Xishan bridge; interchange of Lines 7 and S2.

hist.zh: 明代古桥西善桥得名；7、S2号线换乘站。
hist.en: Named after the Ming-era Xishan bridge; interchange of Lines 7 and S2.

hist.zh: 雨花台区西部产业园区。
hist.en: An industrial park in western Yuhuatai District.

hist.zh: 千年古镇，古渡要冲。
hist.en: An ancient town, long a ferry-crossing hub.

hist.zh: 板桥镇以南新区。
hist.en: The new quarter south of Banqiao town.

hist.zh: 千年古镇，六朝起即为江宁县治。
hist.en: An ancient town serving as Jiangning's county seat since the Six Dynasties.

hist.zh: 长江南岸的临港产业新城。
hist.en: A riverside industrial new town on the Yangtze.

hist.zh: 相传与牧养龙马传说相关的老地名。
hist.en: An old name tied to a legend of pasturing dragon steeds.

hist.zh: 古铜矿井老地名。
hist.en: An old name from ancient copper-mining pits.

hist.zh: 苏皖交界慈湖片区的高新区。
hist.en: A high-tech zone by Cihu at the Jiangsu–Anhui border.

hist.zh: 以马鞍山二中命名的车站。
hist.en: Named after Ma'anshan No. 2 Middle School nearby.

hist.zh: 邻安徽工业大学的车站。
hist.en: The station serving Anhui University of Technology.

hist.zh: 马鞍山雨山东路。
hist.en: Yushan East Road in Ma'anshan.

hist.zh: 近阳湖塘老地名。
hist.en: Named after the old Yanghutang area.

hist.zh: 马鞍山经济技术开发区。
hist.en: Ma'anshan Economic and Technological Development Zone.

hist.zh: 当涂古称姑孰，千年县治。
hist.en: Gushu, the ancient name of Dangtu's county seat.

hist.zh: 相传李白终老于当涂青山，站名纪念诗仙。
hist.en: In memory of Li Bai, who spent his last years by Dangtu's Green Mountain.

hist.zh: 京沪高铁滁州站；S4 滁州段起点，南京段在建。
hist.en: Chuzhou station on the Beijing–Shanghai HSR; the open Chuzhou section starts here.

hist.zh: 滁州花博园景区。
hist.en: The Chuzhou Flower Expo Park.

hist.zh: 醉翁亭所在，欧阳修《醉翁亭记》名山。
hist.en: Home of the Old Drunkard's Pavilion, made famous by Ouyang Xiu's essay.

hist.zh: 滁州市政务新区。
hist.en: Chuzhou's civic-center district.

hist.zh: 苏州—滁州合作产业园核心。
hist.en: Heart of the Suzhou–Chuzhou cooperation industrial park.

hist.zh: 老村落名。
hist.en: An old village name.

hist.zh: 老村落名。
hist.en: An old village name.

hist.zh: 以距城里程得名的老地名。
hist.en: An old name marking the distance from town, twelve and a half li.

hist.zh: 汊河镇新区，近苏皖界。
hist.en: A new town near the Jiangsu–Anhui border.

hist.zh: 清流河与滁河汊流之镇。
hist.en: A town where branching rivers meet.

hist.zh: 相传明初此处为牧马之地，故得名马群；2、S6号线换乘站。
hist.en: Said to be a Ming horse pasture; interchange of Lines 2 and S6.

hist.zh: 旧百水桥老地名。
hist.en: Named after the old Baishui bridge.

hist.zh: 明代外郭城门之一。
hist.en: One of the Ming outer-wall gates.

hist.zh: 城东大型居住小镇。
hist.en: A large residential town on the eastern outskirts.

hist.zh: 汤山古泉村老地名。
hist.en: An old village name by Tangshan's ancient springs.

hist.zh: 1993年出土南京直立人头骨的葫芦洞。
hist.en: The cave where the Nanjing Man skull was unearthed in 1993.

hist.zh: 温泉千年古镇，南朝起即为温泉胜地。
hist.en: A hot-spring town famed since the Six Dynasties.

hist.zh: 汤山新城干道。
hist.en: A main road of the Tangshan new town.

hist.zh: 黄梅村老地名，近句容界。
hist.en: The old Huangmei village near the Jurong border.

hist.zh: 大型主题乐园片区。
hist.en: A major theme-resort district.

hist.zh: 句容古地名，茅山旧称华阳洞天。
hist.en: An old Jurong name; Maoshan was famed as the Huayang grotto-heaven.

hist.zh: 句容城北崇明片区。
hist.en: The Chongming quarter north of Jurong's old town.

hist.zh: 西汉置县，千年古邑，茅山所在。
hist.en: A county founded in the Western Han, gateway to Mount Mao.

hist.zh: 翔宇大道南段车站；S1、S9号线换乘站。
hist.en: Southern Xiangyu Avenue; interchange of Lines S1 and S9.

hist.zh: 横溪铜山老地名。
hist.en: An old place name in the Hengji Tongshan area.

hist.zh: 石臼湖畔古镇，影视基地所在。
hist.en: An old town by Shijiu Lake, home to a film-studio base.

hist.zh: 明觉寺老地名。
hist.en: Named after the old Mingjue temple.

hist.zh: 石臼湖围垦圩区地名。
hist.en: A name from the reclaimed polder fields of Shijiu Lake.

hist.zh: 千年古邑，高淳老街闻名，螃蟹之乡。
hist.en: An ancient county famed for its old street and hairy crabs.
